feature_contract.goal: Eliminate all diagnostic-only R30 counter cache-line writes from the disabled-telemetry stereo CPU-shadow, XYZRHW and SkyGlow paths without changing visible stereo, game state or the enabled statistics.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R30 diagnostic counters on DX9Ex. No game/eye projection math, SkyGlow effect processing, DX11, DXVK, menu, FFB, transport or resource ownership changes.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Remote R30 source at task dispatch had 33 unconditional shared counter increments in CPU-shadow Lock/Unlock/Draw and XYZRHW/ScreenSpace per-primitive fallback paths, despite Present reporting telemetry only under VRTelemetry. Predictable redundant writes and possible cache-line contention are removed; FPS/p95 benefit must be measured on hardware separately.
trace_stages: Original OutRun D3D9 CPU buffer and UI/world draw submits write shadow bytes and per-primitive XYZRHW stereo decisions.
R30 buffers, stereo world/HUD/ScreenSpace fallback and SkyGlow update purely diagnostic shared counter totals at each invocation.
R30 Present reports the counters every five seconds only with VRTelemetry enabled; OpenXR eye composition and actual game drawing remain unchanged.
subcomponents: Retain all 16 stereo, shadow and SkyGlow counter sites under a single telemetry-enabled writer, with no writes on the off route.
Retain equal enabled-telemetry counts and original Present report, while preserving the original fallback, world stereo and SkyGlow pipelines.
Deterministically reject raw increment, missing counter call, forced-always-on writer and forced Present logging mutations.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All 33 diagnostic-only updates across 16 counters bypass their writes when VRTelemetry is disabled.
Enabled logging retains every original counter and report, while guard removal/raw updates/lost routes trigger deterministic verifier failures.
Exact-SHA DX9Ex Active policy, host, full-chain Win32 game compile and package plus Domain Isolation and material source impact complete without CI skip.

diagnosis.original_evidence: 16 R30 diagnostic counters were incremented 33 times throughout CPU-shadow and stereo draw paths even when Settings::VRTelemetry was false; output uses a guarded five-second Present report.
source_trace: CPU Lock/Unlock and shadow hit/miss use plain shared counters while synthesizing CPU copies of VB and IB data.
R30 per-eye XYZRHW world/HUD and ScreenSpace fallback branches increment diagnostics before subsequent stereo or fail-closed routing.
R30 SkyGlow success/failure updates diagnostic totals separately from the actual optical two-eye composite and Present telemetry report.
diagnosis.root_cause: Instrumentation counters were not gated at their producer sites. Disabling the Present report alone did not stop hot-path diagnostic writes.
alternatives_rejected: Suppressing only the Present log does not eliminate per-draw counter writes; that was already in place.
Disabling stereo classification or SkyGlow processing would change visuals and falsely improve performance.
Replacing counters with atomics would increase expensive writes on the off route, not remove them.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: One R30RecordTelemetryCounter helper gates updates for all 16 diagnostic counters; 33 source increments are replaced without touching rendering decisions or resource lifetimes.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Four destructive source mutations cover disabled guard, raw shadow increment, dropped XYZRHW fallback and removed Present opt-out; exact-SHA CI still pending.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Original left/right game draws, direct transport, native HUD/ScreenSpace eye affine, SkyGlow and world-depth ownership are unchanged.

runtime_gate: No Quest3 / VDXR headset, screenshot or FPS frame pacing test was run. RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED.
next_action: Integrate focused negative verifier into canonical exact-SHA policy gate; inspect full Win32 host/game/package, Domain, Full Source Impact on the same validation-bearing SHA. Correct actual failure under task 00826. Do not count score or claim speedup until successful gates.
